a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (2 rounds of operating, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both try to take, the split is random, and two units can't both reach 4 from a reserve of 4. If you agree to operate this round, I'll operate with you every round after, so you can reach 4. I'm saying this openly rather than surprising you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If there's no storm, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve grows for you. Take 4 as soon as it reaches 4 again. I won't take any more.
